title: RFC 8439 ChaCha20 & Zero-Panic X.509 ASN.1 DER Primitives
description: Verify an 8-task Rust security suite combining branchless constant-time ChaCha20 / MAC primitives (RFC 8439 test vectors) with panic-free, CVE-resistant canonical ITU-T X.690 ASN.1 DER certificate parsers.

tasks.title: Constant-time 256-bit MAC / digest equality
tasks.description: Implement branchless ct_eq_32(a: &[u8; 32], b: &[u8; 32]) -> u8 returning 1 iff equal with zero early exit or secret-dependent branches.

tasks.title: Constant-time 16-word conditional state move
tasks.description: Implement branchless ct_cmov_u32(cond: u32, dst: &mut [u32; 16], src: &[u32; 16]) overwriting dst iff cond != 0.

tasks.title: RFC 8439 ChaCha20 ARX quarter-round
tasks.description: Implement strictly branchless, loop-free quarter_round verified against RFC 8439 §2.1.1 / §2.2.1 and 100k random sweeps.

tasks.title: RFC 8439 ChaCha20 64-byte keystream block
tasks.description: Compose quarter_round into a constant-time 20-round ChaCha20 block function verified against RFC 8439 §2.3.2.

tasks.title: Canonical X.690 DER definite length decoder
tasks.description: Implement panic-free parse_der_length rejecting indefinite lengths, overflows (> 4 octets), and non-minimal encodings across 100k fuzz slices.

tasks.title: Zero-panic canonical DER TLV framer
tasks.description: Compose parse_der_length into parse_der_tlv rejecting high-tag-number bytes and overflow/truncation without panicking.

tasks.title: Canonical DER non-negative INTEGER (u64)
tasks.description: Compose parse_der_tlv into parse_der_uint64 enforcing X.690 minimal sign-padding rules and rejecting negative/overflowing values.

tasks.title: Canonical DER OBJECT IDENTIFIER (X.509 OID)
tasks.description: Compose parse_der_tlv into parse_der_oid decoding real X.509 / ML-DSA OIDs while rejecting overlong base-128 encodings and u32 overflows.
